The Square Panel Kids Bed has a grid of softly padded square panels across the headboard. Deep button-style intersections add texture, and the bed is fully upholstered and handmade to order in Dewsbury.

Key features

  • Grid of padded square panels with button-style intersections
  • Fully upholstered enclosed side panels and matching footboard
  • Solid, sturdy frame
  • Handmade to order in West Yorkshire, UK
  • Comes with a wooden slatted base

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £299.00; Small Double (4FT) £299.00; Kids Single (2.6FT) £299.00. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a wooden frame that is fully upholstered. Available in a wide range of colours including Cream, Silver, Grey, Steel, Beige, Red, Green, White, Black, Blue, Pink and Brown, in fabrics such as Plush Velvet and Chenille. Bespoke requests are welcome, and free fabric swatches are available.

Mattress

Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress. If you are unsure which mattress suits your size, especially the Kids Single (2.6FT), call 07417 439197 before you order.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Free delivery applies across Great Britain, by our own team, typically within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. Changed your mind? You can return it free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and we collect it. If anything arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

What does the headboard look like?

A grid of softly padded square panels, with deep button-style intersections for texture.

Is there an adult version of this style?

Yes. See the Square Panel Luxury bed in our adult range.

What sizes does it come in?

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT) and Kids Single (2.6FT), all at £299.00.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

Related: kids beds.

Key features

  • Wooden slatted base

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes, and custom requests are welcome. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Frequently asked questions

Does the star pattern show in every fabric?

The star-inspired shape is part of the headboard panel design, and fabric colour changes how strongly it reads. Free swatches help you choose.

Can I get a two-tone finish?

Yes. Solid colours, stripes and two-tone finishes are available; custom requests are welcome.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

Can I see the fabric first?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can see the colour in your own light before ordering.

p2.descriptionHtml:
The Stone Premium Bed is a premium designer upholstered bed frame with a structured, architectural headboard inspired by natural stone textures. It is handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a wooden slatted base, from £467.99 in Single 3ft to £649.99 in Super King 6ft, with free delivery across Great Britain.

Key features

  • Architectural stone-inspired headboard design
  • Premium padded fabric upholstery
  • Wooden slatted base
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches so you can choose your colour with confidence

Sizes

Available in the sizes below, with prices from the current listing. Not sure which size to choose? See our UK bed sizes guide or email us.

  • Single 3ft: £467.99
  • Small Double 4ft: £545.99
  • Double 4ft6: £558.99
  • King 5ft: £597.99
  • Super King 6ft: £649.99

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop. Choose from Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé fabrics in solid colours, stripes or two-tone; custom fabric and colour options are available on request, and free swatches let you check at home.

Mattress compatibility

This is a bed frame with no built-in storage, on a slatted base that suits standard UK mattresses. Order the size that matches your mattress, or add our Memory Orthopaedic Mattress (from £142.99) or 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress (from £220.99).

Customisation

Stone-inspired designs look good in earthy neutrals, but the choice is yours: solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or a custom fabric and colour on request. Order free swatches to compare.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90.

Changed your mind? You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) as long as the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. If anything arrives faulty we will arrange a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed also carries a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.

See also the Oxygen Luxury Bed, the Grand Princess Luxury Bed, or browse all upholstered beds. Our handmade beds quality guide explains how we build.

FAQ

What is the Stone Premium Bed?

It is an upholstered bed frame whose structured headboard is inspired by natural stone textures, handmade on a wooden frame.

What sizes and prices are available?

Single 3ft £467.99, Small Double 4ft £545.99, Double 4ft6 £558.99, King 5ft £597.99, Super King 6ft £649.99.

Where is it made?

It is handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire.

Can I see the fabric before I buy?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can check colour and feel at home. Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour.

What is your returns policy?

You have 14 days for free returns, with free collection, if the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Not sure on colour? Order free fabric swatches and see the fabric at home before you buy.

The Sunburst Panel Storage Bed brings our fan-panel sunburst headboard shape to a divan base with a drawer, shown in pink velvet. It is a more decorative option for anyone after a statement piece with practical storage underneath.

Sizes

Available in Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT).

Materials & build

Handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a sturdy wooden frame. Available in a wide range of colours including Cream, Silver, Grey, Steel, Beige, Red, Green, White, Black, Blue, Pink and Brown, in fabrics such as Plush Velvet and Chenille. Bespoke fabric, colour and size requests are welcome, and free fabric swatches are available.

Delivery & assembly

FAQ

Does it only come in pink velvet?

Pink velvet is the example shown. Other colours and fabrics are available, and free swatches can be sent.

What sizes does the Sunburst Panel Storage Bed with Drawer come in?

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT).

Yes. It comes in a wide range of colours in fabrics such as Plush Velvet and Chenille. Bespoke requests are welcome, and free swatches can be sent.

Delivery across Great Britain is free and usually takes 3 to 5 working days, as each bed is handmade to order.
